thesis: Jim Dunn argues that modern portfolio theory is outdated and that the industry suffers from a 'sea of sameness' because most managers fail to leverage the computing power enabling new technologies like SaaS. He describes Rosetta Analytics as a 'skunk works' initiative designed to apply machine learning to asset allocation and portfolio construction, noting that while big hedge funds possess similar capabilities, they do not share them due to competitive edges. The investment thesis relies on two specific bets: first, on Julia Bonafede's integrity and status as one of the best minds in investing based on a 20-year relationship, and second, on the strategy's ability to generate successful products that can be seeded with capital.
